details: The American Bankers Association CEO is making a last-minute effort to impose stricter limits on stablecoin rewards before a crucial Senate committee vote. This push could significantly impact the utility and appeal of stablecoins for investors.
title: Stablecoin Rewards Face Tightened Limits Push

details: Michael Saylor's MicroStrategy has resumed its Bitcoin accumulation, purchasing an additional 535 BTC for $43 million. This acquisition increases their total holdings to 818,869 BTC, signaling continued institutional confidence in Bitcoin.
title: MicroStrategy Acquires 535 More Bitcoins for $43M

details: Four years after a significant hack, the Ronin Network, a gaming sidechain, is set to migrate to an Ethereum Layer 2 solution based on the OP Stack. This move aims to enhance security and scalability for the platform.
title: Ronin Network to Migrate to Ethereum Layer 2

details: Neuberger has provided Ripple Prime with a $200 million debt facility to expand its margin lending services. This financial backing is expected to boost Ripple's institutional offerings and market presence.
title: Neuberger Provides Ripple Prime With $200M Debt Line

details: Crypto funds experienced significant inflows of $858 million last week, marking a five-week streak and the strongest weekly total since late April. Bitcoin funds alone attracted over $700 million, with improving sentiment around the Clarity Act cited as a key catalyst.
title: Institutional Inflows Boost Crypto Funds by $858M

details: Bitcoin briefly traded below $80,000 after rallying to nearly $82,500. Analysts at CryptoQuant suggest the recent gains are part of a "bear market rally," and growing profit levels could lead to further selling pressure.
title: Bitcoin Slips Below $80K Amid "Bear Market Rally" Warnings

details: Circle, the issuer of USDC, successfully raised $222 million in a presale for its institutional-focused Arc blockchain. Investors include prominent firms like a16z crypto and BlackRock, highlighting strong interest in institutional blockchain solutions.
title: Circle Raises $222M in Arc Token Presale

details: Analysts indicate that tensions in Iran and increased whale selling activity are casting a shadow over Bitcoin's short-term outlook, despite the cryptocurrency holding above the $81,000 mark.
title: Iran Tensions & Whale Selling Cloud Bitcoin Outlook
